work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CLXXVIII separates New Brunswick from the diocese of Charlottetown and erects it as a diocese; intitulation, narrative, dispositive clause, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause survive (no address in this printing). Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF33244–33244; the source dating clause at LF33321–33325 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die trigesima se- ptembris millesimo octingentesimo quadrage- simo secundo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo secundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
